faq.title: Quick FAQ
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions before you buy.

items.question: How do I choose the right insole?
items.answer: Pick a category based on your use (sport, work, everyday, or kids). Each product page includes details and recommendations. For clinical questions, consult your podiatrist.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: We process orders within 1–2 business days. You'll receive tracking by email once your order leaves our warehouse.

items.question: Can I return a product?
items.answer: Yes, you have 14 days to return unused, non-customized products. See our returns policy for details.

items.question: Are anatomical models for clinical use?
items.answer: They are intended as visual and educational aids. They do not replace individual diagnosis or surgical planning.
